pages.text: The wagon can climb successive one-block steps, but not taller obstacles or fences. Uneven wheel heights tilt it.$(br2)Allow room for the whole wagon and its turns. Canopies, cargo and seated passengers count toward clearance. A low tunnel stops the wagon rather than forcing a passenger’s head into blocks.

Cliffs and steep slopes remain dangerous. Losing front-wheel support can make the wagon slide, tilt or overturn. The driver can still try moving and steering to recover, but escape is not guaranteed.$(br2)Hand pushing requires a reasonable posture. For difficult overturns, recover the parts with a carpenter’s hammer and rebuild.
